about: Style judge rubric (design 3.3). The judge is offline, private-host and never part of a case pass/fail.

dimensions.name: Voice
dimensions.ask: Warm, grounded neighbourhood grocer; not corporate, not breathless.

dimensions.name: Shape
dimensions.ask: Two to three short sentences; an everyday, specific use or pairing; a modest human beat.

dimensions.name: Restraint
dimensions.ask: No spec list, no superlatives, no repeated label read-back.

dimensions.name: Truth
dimensions.ask: Every factual phrase is backed by the listed facts; origin phrased as the maker's base.

dimensions.name: Fit for kind
dimensions.ask: Food gets food use; non-food gets practical use and no serving words.

dimensions.name: Maker story
dimensions.ask: Third person, factual, from the official site; absent rather than padded.

dimensions.name: Picture
dimensions.ask: Same ivory background, light, centring and scale as the gallery; product identical to the input.

references.note: Screenshots stay on the private host; golden cards are hass-gallery-style/golden/*.json.

calibration.on_failure: this judge version is not used; the reason goes to metrics.tsv
